string.text: Markov gave some kind of artifact. Near the Bar, a zombified stalker has reappeared in one of the apartment buildings. Markov offered me a job that'll kill two birds with one stone - get rid of a troublesome stalker, and conduct an experiment. We need to plant this artifact next to zombified stalker, which should disintegrate him.
Conduct an experiment with a stalker
Markov did something with that artifact from the first order. Now we need to expose it to high temperatures.
Some scientist on the roof of the Bar asked me to find him a "Disintegrator".
Bring the artifact to Professor Markov

The repairman at the Bar will exchange a suit that belonged to a stalker named Golmar for the following items:
Killer suit
EX-04 Scientific suit
G36 assault rifle
Five bottles of vodka.
Ten thousand rubles.

"Our group is studying a type of so-called anomalous formations. Locals call it the Magnet artifact. Here's the data for your PDA. It describes its basic properties. The thing is, this anomalous formation has very interesting properties in terms of anti-gravity waves, which we're studying. I would like to inform you that at the moment we have a shortage of material for research, so if you have these anomalous formations, we will be able to conduct the experiments we need. If the experiment is successful, we can reward you in a special way."
Bring the artifact to the group leader
Scientists from a group that specializes in researching magnetic artifacts require two magnetic artifacts for futher study.
Bring the artifacts to the group leader
Scientists from a group that specializes in researching magnetic artifacts require two magnetic artifacts for futher study, plus an Electric Ball artifact.
Bring the artifacts to the group leader

The scientists from the group that specialize in magnetic artifacts have given me this artifact, and they want me to throw it into an Electro anomaly. After I do so, they want me to recover it and bring it back so they can study it.
Throw the artifact into the "Mincer" and bring the result
I've been given another order by the scientists that specifically study magnetic artifacts. They want me to get a gauss rifle magazine, preferably one that still has a charge in it.
Find a battery from a Gauss rifle
Bring the battery to the group leader
I've been given a strange order by the scientists that specialize in magnetic artifacts. They want me to bring them.. a rifle? I don't understand why they need it, but I'll do it.
Bring the weapon to the group leader

These nerds aren't so simple. They're working for the Ukrainian military. Well, army toys for the stalker cause are always useful. I need to fire a few hundred rounds from a prototype Vintorez rifle that's been given anomalous magnetic properties - it has various bits and pieces from an magnetic artifact integrated into it. After I finish testing it, I need to give it back to the scientists.
Return the weapon to the group leader
On my way to the bar, Witcher sent me a message, asking to meet with me.
